Name: AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Serum
Short description: Pakistan's most-reviewed serum. The mini sells as well as the 50 ml.
Tags: Mini, Korea, Bestseller, Dark spots, Dullness
Meta: _nx_tagline: Pakistan's most-reviewed serum. The mini sells as well as the 50 ml.
Meta: _nx_good_for:
Dark spots or sun spots
Marks left behind by acne
Dull, uneven skin tone
Oily, combination or normal skin
Meta: _nx_not_for:
You have active, painful breakouts
Your skin is very dry and tight
You won't wear sunscreen daily
Meta: _nx_ingredients:
Niacinamide 5% | Main active | Helps fade dark spots, evens tone and controls oil
Sea buckthorn | Antioxidant | Helps skin look brighter
Mulberry & licorice | Tone support | Plant extracts used to help even out skin tone
Squalane | Hydration | Light moisture without a greasy finish
Meta: _nx_howto:
Wash with a gentle face wash.
Press 2-3 drops into face and neck, morning and night.
Moisturise if your skin feels dry.
In the morning, finish with SPF 50.
Meta: _nx_faq:
How soon will I see results? | Most people see a brighter look in 1-2 weeks and lighter marks in 4-8 weeks, with daily sunscreen.
Can I use it with vitamin C or retinol? | Yes. Use vitamin C in the morning and retinol at night.
Which size should I buy? | Start with the 5 ml mini to test it. The 50 ml costs about half as much per ml.
